items.question: What exactly is AI Rumpelstiltskin?
items.answer: It is a generator that turns one photo into a Rumpelstiltskin-style dancing video, inspired by the viral clip that took over the internet. Upload a photo, generate, download.

items.question: Do I need to write a prompt?
items.answer: No. That is the whole point - zero prompts, zero editing. You bring the photo, the little guy brings the dance.

items.question: What photos work best?
items.answer: One clear subject, front-facing, decent lighting. Crowded shots and heavy motion blur confuse the spin.

items.question: Can I use pets or characters?
items.answer: Yes. People, pets, and original characters all get a turn at the mic. Just keep it to one subject per photo.

items.question: Who owns the clips I make?
items.answer: You do. Post them on your feeds, in your group chats, wherever. Just make sure you have the rights to the photo you upload.

items.question: How much does it cost?
items.answer: Credits, not subscriptions. Grab a pack on the pricing page and spend it as you spin. No monthly trap.
